That's a long time to be in the business of taking it well. And "everybody kept saying" — so the performance got applause, which makes it harder to ever put down.

There's a difference, though, between what you did with Marcus and what you do with your mom. With Marcus you were protecting a kid who didn't need your night. With her, you're still collecting the approval for taking it well — except now the thing you're taking well is your own life.

Does she know that's the role you've been playing, or does she just think that's who you are?
